name: Dropbox Dash
tagline: AI universal search across your apps, files, and tools.
description: Dropbox Dash is an AI-powered universal search and knowledge workspace that indexes content across connected apps — Google Drive, OneDrive, Notion, Slack, and more — to return instant, sourced answers. It adds a unified start page, AI writing tools, and admin access controls, plus a business tier for teams.
insight: Built on Command E, the desktop search startup Dropbox acquired in 2021 and rebranded as Dash.
edge: Searches across your connected SaaS apps and files from one bar, and its business tier runs self-hosted AI so content stays in Dropbox's trust boundary.
cons: Best value needs many connected apps
Richer features gated to paid tiers
